## Review swarm findings

Pinned diff: `e8e65e9330cc8c643190e74f72f00995153872e5..bb31401ce3323b8e4cef85a7f210f46ce812e417`

Fresh-context lanes: domain, adversarial, correctness, security, quality. All five lanes ran read-only against the pinned PR #150 range or the pinned head.

Findings:

- HIGH: delegated promoter provenance can record the effective namespace instead of the bearer-token promoter identity. `docs/identity-boundary.md` says `promoted_by` is derived from authenticated promoter identity, but `src/promotion-service.ts` writes `auth.clientId`; delegated promoter requests can set `clientId` from `X-Namespace` while preserving the real token identity in `auth.tokenClientId`. Fix: write `auth.tokenClientId ?? auth.clientId` and add a regression test.
- MEDIUM: #147 was closed without the live identity checks its acceptance criteria required. PR #150 left the live smoke checkbox unchecked and added docs/test hooks, but no live receipt for Bilby/Skippy/Rico shared-kb reads, normal shared-write denial, promoter provenance, or audit/log identity.
- MEDIUM: the critical self-review gate is visible in the PR template but not mechanically enforced. Future PR bodies can omit the section or leave boilerplate. Fix: add a lightweight PR-body check or explicit approved bypass path.
- MEDIUM/P2: the PR template does not surface the repo's SME review-memory update requirement. Fix: add a template checklist item requiring `docs/sme/` update or explicit not-applicable note.

Clean/confirmed lanes:

- Domain found no material issue for #148's already-present self-review docs baseline, but confirmed #147 live-proof evidence was missing.
- Correctness independently confirmed the delegated provenance mismatch and ran focused tests at pinned head: `bun test src/auth.test.ts src/rest-promotion.test.ts` passed, 29 pass / 0 fail.
- Security independently confirmed the same delegated provenance bug and ran focused auth/promotion tests as a smoke check.
- Quality confirmed `git diff --check` passed on the pinned PR range.

Disposition:

- Findings are accepted. Fix work is starting under #151 on a clean `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/_tmp` worktree.
